Lovely Local Pastry Spot!

We were staying nearby for the weekend and found this gem — so glad we did! 🥐 Everything was delicious and super reasonably priced. They accept card, which was convenient, and even though English wasn’t fluent, they were so kind and tried to help/translate — really appreciated that!

I’m vegetarian and got a cheese pastry which was amazing 😍 Plus a pain au chocolat and a few others — all so good. On our last day, I grabbed a box to take home before catching the Eurostar, and my family loved them too! Would highly recommend if you’re in the area! 🥰
Mauvaise qualité, se dit "artisan" boulangerie ... honteux. Viennoiseries extrêmement sèches et absolument pas maison, comment peut-on être commerçant et vouloir servir un truc pareil ...
